amendment.description: An amendment numbered 4 printed in Part A of House Report 119-749 to require nations to pay the U.S. for military training exercise rather than receive them as a grant or at no-cost.

vote.text: On agreeing to the Crane amendment (A003) Agreed to by voice vote.

action.text: House amendment agreed to: On agreeing to the Crane amendment (A003) Agreed to by voice vote.
